nap.name: Hotel Elegant Executive Suites Multan

rates_pkr_per_night_pre_tax.tax_note: GST 16% + Multan city tax 10% (26% total) added at booking

offers.name: Early Booking Offer
offers.condition: Book at least 7 days before check-in

offers.name: Last Minute Deal
offers.condition: Check-in today or tomorrow; Thu/Fri/Sat check-in; booked 15:00-23:59 PKT

offer_rule: The biggest discount wins. A deal applies only when it is cheaper than the room's offer price.

policies.payment: Regular rate: pay at the hotel, advance optional. Deals: full advance by bank transfer.
policies.cancellation: Change or cancel any time via WhatsApp or call. Deals: 100% refund before check-in (not after a stay).
policies.children: Aged 10 and above welcome. Extra bed PKR 2,500 per person per night. No cots or cribs.
policies.id: Valid address and phone; ID may be requested
policies.amenities: Free WiFi, free private parking, 24-hour reception, room service, airport shuttle on request (airport about 7 km), complimentary breakfast buffet (Halal, continental, Asian)

open_items: Booking.com parity for the new rates is not yet checked. Website offer must stay at or below Booking.com Genius-3.
Website copy must not say 'no advance payment' on a deal, and must not use the old '16% + 10%' tax line.
